override._why: Story Mode's Stage Select (from about 50-130 s, after the intro) needs the monkey moved onto a stage ball ('Select a stage with the Left Thumbstick'), where A alone does nothing; the d-pad moves it too. Every 10 s from 50 to 150 s: Down 300 ms, Right 300 ms, A (in the story text A only advances, in play the ball only rolls).
